description: This file contains mock data and functions related to wireless network configurations, including basic, advanced, WPS, and mesh data, for testing purposes in a web UI project.

methods.name: simulateWpsPairing
methods.description: Simulates the WPS pairing process, updating pairing state with random success or failure after a delay.

methods.name: getWlanWpsMock
methods.description: Returns the current WPS mock data with the latest pairing state.

methods.name: updateWlanWpsMock
methods.description: Updates WPS mock data, including enabling/disabling and initiating pairing actions.
